# jschoenberg.github.io
Repo for blog/website/whatever I want it to be

## Adding posts

- Daily notes go in `_daily/` with a filename like `2026-09-06-a-new-note.md`.
- Longer pieces go in `_ramblings/` with a filename like `2026-09-06-a-longer-thought.md`.
- Both use simple Markdown and need front matter with a `title`.
- Edit `board.md` to update The Board.
